## Done gate

- [ ] `npm run check` green (+ `test:e2e` for UI, `test:perf` for bundle)
- [ ] `/code-review` run, confirmed findings fixed
- [ ] Docs + open items (`docs/solution-plan/SOLUTION-PLAN.md`) updated; ADR if a decision changed
- [ ] Commits signed off (`-s`), no AI co-author
- [ ] Target: feature → `development`; release → `main`. Never another feature branch: a stacked PR merged after its base strands the work
- [ ] Rules or functions changed: say so, deploy order is rules then functions ([DEPLOYMENT](../docs/guides/DEPLOYMENT.md#release-checklist))
